newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 19.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Peruvian guerillas hold over two hundred people at the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima, demand government release from jail some 500 militants and change economic policy.
-- Elf Aquitaine says may disengage from pharmaceuticals unit Sanofi in which it holds 53 percent, if Sanofi plans to merge with other pharmaceutical laboratories.
-- Managers of defence group Thomson-CSF call for a public float of shares rather than a privatisation through private placement.
-- Central bank authorities issue warnings, seek to prevent rise of a seculative financial bubble in a climate of euphoria on the major world exchanges.
-- Prices of water to rise five percent yearly through 2001, environnment and finance ministers say, due to rising costs of water treatment against pollution.
-- European telecommunications minister reach agreement in principle on postal service deregulation.
-- New insurance unit created by a recent AXA -UAP merger to be known worldwide under the brand name AXA.
-- Government plan to support areas hit by defence sector restructuring from 1997 to be presented by defence minister Charles Millon in Lyon today.
